aggregation: sum integer counts within donor x condition x selected cell type
multiplicity: BH across all retained genes in this one cell type
prerequisites: at least two complete independent donor pairs

evidence_separation.real: public expression counts and published donor/cell annotations
evidence_separation.simulated: scientist certificates, initial transcription error, world actions

limitations: Published cell labels are reused; annotation accuracy is not evaluated.
The condition contrast is within donors; condition-associated processing effects cannot be ruled out by this benchmark.
Reference agreement tests the specified method, not universal biological truth.
No formal score or scientific completion before independent method review.
